blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The Bases Conversion and Development Authority (BCDA) is preparing to partner with the private sector to give Baguio’s iconic Camp John Hay a multibillion-peso makeover, upgrading the former American recreational base. Less than two years after taking over the estate, the state-run corporation has already begun a sweeping makeover under a refreshed master plan, with improvements ranging from hotel upgrades to fixing “spaghetti wires.” READ: Baguio asks for full audit of John Hay structures, profits Among the projects lined up for bidding in the fourth quarter is a long-term operations and maintenance (O&M) contract for The John Hay Hotels, […]...
